Search engine (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection errors for every query, and zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403, so no domestic-supply record could be read. Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not refuted — null, not invented.
note: Declared HS 850490 (static converters/UPS parts) does NOT match the customs records seen: actual HS codes on the visible rows are 85423300 (amplifiers), 85423100 (ICs/processors) and, on the import side, 84714900 and 85369090. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base with the HS code corrected to the factual one (semiconductor/electronic-component trading, HS 8542/8541 family), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: trader — the visible rows are buy-and-resell of branded parts (Arrow Electronics, Digi-Key, Kinji Electronics, Vidgitech) with no manufacturing evidence, so manufacturer/trader classification = trader. Evidence quality caveat: the 108-shipment figure is the site's own counter, only 5 rows were actually readable; the export direction is confirmed by two dated B/L rows (4025498 to Hong Kong 2025-09-03; 1411714 to Hong Kong 2025-04-30) plus buyer aggregates, so export_status = confirmed on those specific records, not on the counter. Note the Russia link (EMT LLC, Moscow; Vidgitech LLC, Novorossiysk import lane) — neutral fact, not a rejection ground. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null (not public in free views). PAN AAQFH4038P and Karnataka/Bangalore location are consistent with the Bangalore air-cargo port lanes but were not independently verified in a registry (registries out of scope for this role).
